title: A grieving community, prenatal acetaminophen, ‘alien tortoises’: Catch up on the day’s stories | CNN
text:
👋Welcome to 5 Things PM!This Japanese bodybuilder just won his 19th national title. Oh, and he’s 90 years old.See what’s fueling his success.

Here’s what else you might have missed during your busy day.

An engaged reporter, a soon-to-retire pilot and a young tourist. Instead of celebrating the next chapter of their lives, the loved ones of the three people killed in a news helicopter crash in Los Angeles are nowcoping with an unimaginable loss.

A new study found that girls born to mothers who took acetaminophen during pregnancy could have theirfertility affected later in life. But doctors say it remains safe to use when needed.

About 13 years ago,“American Idol” contestant Caleb Flynngushed about his wife Ashley on national TV. Now he is on trial for her murder and has pleaded not guilty.

A tiny rural village in central England voted tosplit from the United Kingdomin protest over a nearby migrant center. The result holds no legal weight, but it is the latest sign of growing tensions surrounding migration.

These “alien” tortoises once roamed the Galápagos Islands by the hundreds of thousands. After 150 years of absence,they’re making a remarkable return.

🔥 Hillside blaze:A wildfire broke out in Northern California, burning hundreds of acres andshutting down a major highway. Officials say the cause of the fire remains under investigation.

🎨 Grief, joy and what remains:From bold floral interiors to color-soaked installations, Yinka Ilori has built a reputation as amaster of dopamine design.
